meta.title: Frankencoin for partners: accept, hold and move Swiss francs on-chain
meta.description: Integrate ZCHF in payments, treasury or banking products. Regulated on-ramps, MiCAR classification, eight chains, no issuer to negotiate with.

hero.title: The Swiss franc your product can plug into.
hero.subtitle: ZCHF is an ERC-20 on eight chains with a public legal classification, no issuer and no permission needed. Retailers, card issuers, exchanges and banks already use it.

doors.title: Accept ZCHF
doors.body: Point of sale, e-commerce or invoices. Spar accepts it in stores; GnosisPay cards spend it anywhere Visa works.

doors.title: Offer ZCHF
doors.body: Mt Pelerin and DFX let customers buy with a bank transfer, fully compliant. List it, or route through them.

doors.title: Hold and earn
doors.body: Park CHF on-chain at the protocol rate, or use ZCHF as collateral and liquidity on Curve, Uniswap, Morpho.

items.title: No issuer
items.description: Nobody can freeze, blacklist or redeem on your behalf. The contract is the counterparty.

items.title: Clear legal status
items.description: Swiss payment-token classification and an EU MiCAR opinion, both public. A MiCA-format white paper is filed with ESMA.

items.title: Eight chains
items.description: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Gnosis, Avalanche, Sonic, bridged with Chainlink CCIP.

items.title: Deep CHF liquidity
items.description: Curve and Uniswap pools, DEX aggregators, and regulated fiat ramps for size.

cta.title: Want ZCHF in your product?
cta.body: The Frankencoin Association helps with listings, integrations and grants. One email is enough.
